note: Access Bank's rates guide for personal accounts: its savings accounts carry no account maintenance charge (their quarterly debit card maintenance fee of 53.75 naira belongs to the card, and the 50 naira levy to transfers). Its Individual Current account's maintenance fee is 1 naira per thousand of debit turnover, a charge on spending that the game doesn't count, so the savings account is taken.
